alex: Thanks for the runtime Q&A — short follow-up thread for owners. recording + slides: https://redwood.internal/s/rt-roadmap :wave:

jade: Quick tl;dr from the runtime team: (1) minor memory/perf fixes rolling next 2w, (2) attention fusion prototype end of Q2, (3) int8 path prototype mid-Q3. wont change checkpoints or API.

michael: Are we shipping any Console UX to toggle the new kernels for Dedicated customers?

jade: Yes — preview toggle per pool + impact estimator. UX will be opt-in for orgs.

sam: Can you share the adaptive batching defaults again? Want to align SDKs.

jade: Paste from the RFC we discussed:

```
adaptive_batching:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 25
  target_p95_ms: 120
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

lia: I'll take the migration checklist and the customer-facing note. Putting together a short migration playbook with steps + rollback.

alex: Owners: Jade -> rollout gating doc by Mon; Lia -> migration playbook draft by Wed; Michael -> SDK default PR by Fri; Sam -> benchmark validations for chat workloads.

deploy-bot: Slides uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/rt-roadmap/slides.pdf :white_check_mark:

alex: If anyone has follow-ups from the live Q, drop them here. Ill consolidate and send a single follow-up email to execs after the playbook is ready. :thumbsup:
